headline: American Express (AXP) Preferred Offering Puts Its Undervalued Narrative Back In Focus
summary: American Express (AXP) has drawn fresh attention after completing a US$1.6b fixed income offering of preferred depository shares, giving investors another lens on the company alongside its common stock performance and recent earnings commentary. See our latest analysis for American Express. Against this backdrop, American Express shares trade at US$340.91, with a 90 day share price return of 7.87% even as the year to date share price return is down 8.54%.
